added: Vietnamese: Latin-1 Supplement U+00C0-U+00FF, Latin Extended-A U+0100-U+017F, Latin Extended-B U+0180-U+024F (Ơ ơ, Ư ư), Latin Extended Additional U+1EA0-U+1EFF, Combining Diacritical Marks U+0300-U+036F, plus basic Latin / CJK punctuation already in the base corpus
note: Use this file AS corpus_codepoints.json when building a VI JP payload (jp_crc/bundles.py reads corpus_codepoints.json). With the original corpus, every Vietnamese diacritic (685 codepoints, e.g. à á ả ã ạ ă â ê ô ơ ư đ) is missing and font subsetting would drop those glyphs. The game font must actually contain these glyphs; if a JP font lacks Vietnamese outlines, subsetting keeps nothing and the text will show as boxes — check font coverage first.
